{{Quote|Ambush! Sarge is hit! We need the Jedi back here!|[[Garcy]] at the Battle of Essien|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic: War 1">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 1|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Sarge''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phaeda/Legends|Phaeda]]. He was a [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] in the [[Phaeda Militia]], and was killed by [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] in the [[Essien landing]].
